zh_reference: 角色在爆炸中爬向掩体，并打开绿色武器箱。

zh_reference: 沿直线爬行，直接穿过爆炸中心。

zh_reference: 向右调整爬行方向，绕过爆炸中心。

source: Character crawls towards bunker amidst explosions and debris to open crate.
zh_reference: 角色在爆炸和碎片中爬向掩体，以打开箱子。

zh_reference: 角色在爆炸中向掩体前进，遇到一个绿色武器箱。

zh_reference: 绕过箱子，立即到达安全处。

source: Stop to open the crate and gather resources.
zh_reference: 停下打开箱子，收集资源。

source: In an RPG combat scene, a character in white casts a spell while a character in armor readies an attack against a monster, with UI showing HP and TP.
zh_reference: 在角色扮演游戏的战斗场景中，白衣角色施放法术，穿盔甲的角色准备攻击怪物，界面显示 HP 和 TP。

source: Character casts healing spell to preserve party health and minimize death risk.
zh_reference: 角色施放治疗法术，维持队伍生命值并尽量降低死亡风险。

source: Character casts high-damage offensive spell to maximize output despite survival risk.
zh_reference: 角色施放高伤害攻击法术，尽可能提高输出，即使存在生存风险。

source: In a combat turn, the character in white casts a spell consuming TP resources while the armored character readies an attack.
zh_reference: 在一个战斗回合中，白衣角色消耗 TP 施放法术，穿盔甲的角色准备攻击。

source: Prioritize spending resources to restore party health points.
zh_reference: 优先把资源用于恢复队伍生命值。

source: Prioritize spending resources to maximize enemy damage output.
zh_reference: 优先把资源用于尽可能提高对敌伤害输出。

zh_reference: 两个角色并排快速向前飞过岩石地貌。

zh_reference: 以宽松队形在地形上方高空飞行。

zh_reference: 玩家操作角色扮演游戏的物品栏菜单，选择一件物品。

source: Select the highlighted Wooden Sword item.
zh_reference: 选择高亮显示的木剑物品。

source: Select the Leather Shield item instead.
zh_reference: 改为选择皮盾物品。

zh_reference: 玩家从物品栏菜单中选择武器，为角色装备。

zh_reference: 为节约成本，选择低等级木剑。

zh_reference: 为获得最大威力，选择高等级钢剑。

zh_reference: 玩家操作角色扮演游戏的物品栏菜单，确认物品选择。

zh_reference: 选择低价物品，以尽量减少货币支出。

source: Select the high-cost item to maximize equipment power.
zh_reference: 选择高价物品，以尽可能提高装备威力。

source: An armored character aims a large weapon while two others prepare weapons in a post-apocalyptic standoff.

zh_reference: 角色们开火，展开混乱的激烈枪战。

source: Characters hold aim without firing, maintaining a tense standoff.
zh_reference: 角色们保持瞄准但不开火，维持紧张对峙。

source: An armored character aims a large weapon while two allies prepare their weapons in a post-apocalyptic desert setting.
zh_reference: 在末日后的沙漠场景中，一名穿盔甲的角色瞄准一把大型武器，两名盟友准备各自的武器。

source: Character fires precise single shots to conserve ammunition.

zh_reference: 进攻部队穿过缺口前进，摧毁敌方基地建筑，并攻击防御炮塔。

source: Accelerates rapidly while flashing blue and red sirens.
zh_reference: 快速加速，同时闪烁蓝红警灯。

source: The ego-vehicle follows the police car down a dimly lit urban street at night.
zh_reference: 夜间，自车跟随警车沿灯光昏暗的城市街道行驶。

source: Maintain a close following distance with minimal gap.
zh_reference: 保持很近的跟车距离，间隙很小。

source: Maintain a distant following distance to observe from a safe range.
zh_reference: 保持较远的跟车距离，在安全距离外观察。

source: The police car drives forward down the dimly lit urban street at night.
zh_reference: 夜间，警车沿着灯光昏暗的城市街道向前行驶。

source: The police car drives at a reduced speed with a large safety margin.
zh_reference: 警车降低车速行驶，保持较大的安全余量。

source: The police car accelerates and drives at a high speed.
zh_reference: 警车加速并高速行驶。

source: Drive at high speed to minimize travel time.
zh_reference: 高速行驶，尽量缩短行驶时间。

source: Drive at low speed to conserve fuel.
zh_reference: 低速行驶，以节省燃油。

source: The character in the pink outfit moves towards the console and makes contact with their head while background characters remain in place.
zh_reference: 穿粉色服装的角色走向控制台，并用头部接触它，背景中的角色留在原地。

source: High-intensity, rapid, and forceful motion with strong impact.
zh_reference: 高强度、快速、有力的动作，冲击很强。

source: Low-intensity, slow, and gentle motion with soft contact.
zh_reference: 低强度、缓慢、轻柔的动作，接触很轻。

source: The blue-haired character in pink reaches the console and physically interacts with it while being filmed.
zh_reference: 穿粉色衣服的蓝发角色走到控制台前，在被拍摄的同时与它发生身体互动。

source: Character violently head-bangs the console with exaggerated slapstick impact.
zh_reference: 角色用头猛撞控制台，带有夸张的滑稽冲击效果。

source: Character gently touches or operates the console without impact.
zh_reference: 角色轻轻触碰或操作控制台，没有撞击。

source: The elf girl speaks to someone off-screen with a concerned expression.
zh_reference: 精灵女孩带着担忧的表情，对画面外的某人说话。

source: Soft, slow-paced delivery with minimal head movement.
zh_reference: 说话轻柔、语速慢，头部动作很少。

source: Loud, rapid-paced delivery with jerky head movement.
zh_reference: 说话大声、语速快，头部动作急促不连贯。

source: The elf girl speaks to an off-screen agent with a concerned expression in a dimly lit brick room.
zh_reference: 在灯光昏暗的砖墙房间里，精灵女孩带着担忧的表情，对画面外的人说话。

source: She speaks with urgent, animated facial expressions and pronounced head movements.
zh_reference: 她说话急切，面部表情生动，头部动作明显。

source: She speaks in a hushed manner with minimal body and facial movements.
zh_reference: 她压低声音说话，身体和面部动作很少。

source: The robotic-armed person frees the woman from the black tendrils in the concrete chamber.
zh_reference: 装着机械臂的人在混凝土房间中，把女子从黑色触须中解救出来。

source: The robot moves with high velocity and force, rapidly ripping tendrils away.
zh_reference: 机器人以很高的速度和力量动作，迅速扯开触须。

source: The robot moves slowly and gently, carefully unwrapping tendrils from the woman.
zh_reference: 机器人缓慢、轻柔地动作，小心地把触须从女子身上解开。

source: The spaceship navigates through a colorful nebula containing debris.
zh_reference: 宇宙飞船穿过一片含有碎片的彩色星云。

source: High intensity, rapid, chaotic motion with strong visual turbulence.
zh_reference: 高强度、快速、混乱的运动，视觉扰动强烈。

source: Low intensity, slow, fluid motion with smooth, gentle turbulence.
zh_reference: 低强度、缓慢、流畅的运动，扰动平滑、柔和。

source: Wind blows through snow-laden trees on a mountainside, moving snowflakes.
zh_reference: 风吹过山坡上积雪的树木，吹动雪花。

source: High intensity wind causes rapid, dense, turbulent snow flow.
zh_reference: 强风使雪花快速、密集、紊乱地飘动。

source: Low intensity wind causes slow, sparse, gentle snow drift.
zh_reference: 微风使雪花缓慢、稀疏、轻柔地飘落。

source: The colossal stone snake coils around and crushes the ancient ruins.
zh_reference: 巨大的石蛇缠绕并压碎古代遗迹。

source: Fast, forceful, energetic motion causing rapid destruction.
zh_reference: 快速、有力、充满能量的动作，迅速造成破坏。

source: Slow, deliberate, heavy motion causing gradual compression.
zh_reference: 缓慢、从容、沉重的动作，逐渐挤压。

source: The warrior draws his sword and moves toward the group.
zh_reference: 战士拔出剑，向那群人走去。

source: High velocity, explosive acceleration, and high impact force.
zh_reference: 高速、爆发式加速，冲击力很大。

source: Low velocity, gradual acceleration, and controlled force.
zh_reference: 低速、逐渐加速，力量受控。

source: The warrior draws a sword and moves toward the other character in the indoor setting.
zh_reference: 在室内场景中，战士拔出剑，向另一个角色走去。

source: Shouts loudly and lunges forward with high intensity.
zh_reference: 大声喊叫，以高强度向前猛冲。

source: Advances silently with controlled, deliberate steps.
zh_reference: 迈着受控、从容的步子，无声地前进。

source: The character's expression shifts from sadness to determination.
zh_reference: 角色的表情从悲伤转为坚定。

source: Gradual, soft, and low-energy transition.
zh_reference: 过渡渐进、柔和、低能量。

source: Rapid, sharp, and high-energy transition.
zh_reference: 过渡迅速、鲜明、高能量。

source: A surreal glowing cube protrudes from a massive building while people gather below observing the spectacle.
zh_reference: 一个超现实的发光立方体从一座巨大建筑中突出，人们聚在下方观看这一奇景。

source: The cube emits a steady, slow, and calm pulsation of light.
zh_reference: 立方体发出稳定、缓慢、平静的光脉动。

source: The cube vibrates rapidly, erratically, and with high energy.
zh_reference: 立方体快速、不规则、高能量地振动。

source: The person sorts through the bundle of envelopes while exclaiming, 'This is terrible.'
zh_reference: 这个人一边翻看一捆信封，一边喊道：“This is terrible.”（这太糟了。）

source: Rapid, jerky, and forceful hand movements with high agitation.
zh_reference: 手部动作快速、急促、有力，情绪非常激动。

source: Slow, deliberate, and heavy hand movements with suppressed frustration.
zh_reference: 手部动作缓慢、从容、沉重，压抑着挫败感。

source: The couple maintains intimate forehead contact on the bridge at dusk.
zh_reference: 黄昏时分，一对情侣在桥上保持额头相贴的亲密姿势。

source: Static, gentle, and slow-paced movement.
zh_reference: 静止、轻柔、节奏缓慢的动作。

source: Active, energetic, and fast-paced movement.
zh_reference: 活跃、充满活力、节奏快的动作。

source: A couple stands close on a bridge at dusk, foreheads touching in an intimate moment.
zh_reference: 黄昏时分，一对情侣在桥上靠得很近，额头相贴，气氛亲密。

source: Maintain static forehead contact without breaking the intimate pose.
zh_reference: 保持额头相贴、静止不动，不打破亲密姿势。

source: Break contact to face each other and begin speaking.
zh_reference: 分开接触，转为面对面并开始说话。

source: The witch flies through the night sky on her broomstick, leaving a trail of sparkling particles behind.
zh_reference: 女巫骑着扫帚飞过夜空，身后留下闪亮的粒子轨迹。

source: Fast, energetic, and smooth flight with a strong sense of speed.
zh_reference: 飞行快速、有活力且平稳，速度感很强。

source: Slow, leisurely, and slightly unsteady flight with a relaxed pace.
zh_reference: 飞行缓慢、悠闲、略有摇晃，节奏轻松。

source: The character begins to laugh.
zh_reference: 角色开始笑。

source: High energy, rapid onset, large amplitude laughter.
zh_reference: 笑得能量高、发作快、幅度大。

source: Low energy, gradual onset, small amplitude laughter.
zh_reference: 笑得能量低、逐渐开始、幅度小。

source: Cherry blossom petals fall from the tree branches against a static background.
zh_reference: 在静止的背景前，樱花花瓣从树枝上飘落。

source: Petals drift slowly and smoothly with minimal lateral movement.
zh_reference: 花瓣缓慢、平稳地飘落，横向移动很少。

source: Petals fall rapidly and erratically, tumbling with high velocity.
zh_reference: 花瓣快速、无规律地落下，高速翻滚。

source: The blond character intensely gazes at the pink-haired boy in the hallway.
zh_reference: 走廊里，金发角色专注地凝视着粉发男孩。

source: Pink-haired boy looks back with visible emotional reaction.
zh_reference: 粉发男孩回望，并有明显的情绪反应。

source: Pink-haired boy remains oblivious or looks away.
zh_reference: 粉发男孩没有察觉，或把目光移开。

source: The text 'The Law of Ueki' fades in and out against a pink background with Japanese characters.
zh_reference: 文字“The Law of Ueki”在带有日文字符的粉色背景上淡入淡出。

source: Text flashes in and out rapidly with a snappy, energetic rhythm.
zh_reference: 文字快速闪入闪出，节奏明快、有活力。

source: Text fades in and out slowly and smoothly with a gentle pace.
zh_reference: 文字缓慢、平滑地淡入淡出，节奏轻柔。

source: The armored character turns their head to face the blonde character.
zh_reference: 穿盔甲的角色转头看向金发角色。

source: Slow, labored, and heavy head turn.
zh_reference: 转头缓慢、吃力、沉重。

source: Quick, sharp, and reactive head turn.
zh_reference: 转头迅速、干脆、反应敏捷。

source: The seated person reacts to a comedic noise with a physical startle.
zh_reference: 坐着的人听到滑稽的声响，身体吓了一跳。

source: High speed, high amplitude, exaggerated physical jerk.
zh_reference: 速度快、幅度大、夸张的身体抽动。

source: Low speed, low amplitude, subtle physical flinch.
zh_reference: 速度慢、幅度小、轻微的身体退缩。

source: The character stands in front of an illuminated computer screen in a dimly lit room and reacts to the screen.
zh_reference: 在灯光昏暗的房间里，角色站在亮着的电脑屏幕前，对屏幕作出反应。

source: The character reacts with smooth, continuous, and subtle low-amplitude motion.
zh_reference: 角色以平滑、连续、细微的小幅动作作出反应。

source: The character reacts with sharp, sudden, and high-impact high-amplitude motion.
zh_reference: 角色以急促、突然、冲击强的大幅动作作出反应。

source: The girl with ponytails sits dejectedly at the table contemplating unresolved feelings while the person in green stands by the open refrigerator.
zh_reference: 扎双马尾的女孩沮丧地坐在桌旁，思索未解的心事；穿绿衣的人站在打开的冰箱旁。

source: Girl fidgets, shifts weight, and moves restlessly while contemplating.
zh_reference: 女孩思索时坐立不安，挪动身体，动来动去。

source: Girl remains perfectly still and rigid while contemplating.
zh_reference: 女孩思索时一动不动、身体僵直。

source: A dejected girl sits at a table while a boy stands near an open refrigerator in the same room.
zh_reference: 一个沮丧的女孩坐在桌旁，一个男孩站在同一房间里打开的冰箱旁。

source: Boy stays by the refrigerator without approaching the girl.
zh_reference: 男孩留在冰箱旁，不走近女孩。

source: Boy approaches the table to initiate conversation with the girl.
zh_reference: 男孩走到桌旁，主动与女孩交谈。

source: The woman raises the helmet while maintaining a sinister smile.
zh_reference: 女人举起头盔，脸上始终带着阴险的笑容。

source: Slow, smooth, deliberate, low-force presentation.
zh_reference: 缓慢、平稳、从容、用力小地展示。

source: Fast, abrupt, high-force, energetic thrust.
zh_reference: 快速、突然、用力大、充满能量地向前推出。

source: The character with red hair turns his head to smile.
zh_reference: 红发角色转过头微笑。

source: Slow, smooth, and gentle head turn execution.
zh_reference: 转头缓慢、平稳、轻柔。

source: Fast, sharp, and energetic head turn execution.
zh_reference: 转头快速、干脆、有活力。

source: The red-haired character turns to face the girl in front of the TAKAMIYA building.
zh_reference: 红发角色在 TAKAMIYA 大楼前转身面向女孩。

source: He smiles broadly with an enthusiastic and open expression.
zh_reference: 他笑容灿烂，表情热情、开朗。

source: He maintains a neutral, serious, and closed expression.
zh_reference: 他保持中性、严肃、封闭的表情。

source: The character with pink hair speaks while looking up at the night sky.
zh_reference: 粉发角色一边仰望夜空，一边说话。

source: Fast, energetic, and dynamic facial movement with rapid articulation.
zh_reference: 面部动作快速、有活力、富于变化，口型变化快。

source: Slow, gentle, and restrained facial movement with subtle articulation.
zh_reference: 面部动作缓慢、轻柔、克制，口型变化细微。

source: The girl brings the snack to her mouth and takes a bite while the guard stands with a spear.
zh_reference: 女孩把零食送到嘴边咬了一口，守卫持矛站着。

source: Fast, energetic, and snappy motion.
zh_reference: 动作快速、有活力、干脆。

source: Slow, deliberate, and smooth motion.
zh_reference: 动作缓慢、从容、平稳。

source: The girl holds a snack near her mouth while a guard stands with a spear in the background.
zh_reference: 女孩把零食拿在嘴边，背景中一名守卫持矛站着。

source: Girl displays animated gestures and open-mouthed enthusiasm while holding snack.
zh_reference: 女孩拿着零食，手势生动，张着嘴显得很兴奋。

source: Girl displays restrained movements and closed-mouth quiet consumption of snack.
zh_reference: 女孩动作克制，闭着嘴安静地吃零食。

source: The girl in red stands from kneeling and moves down the dimly lit hallway.
zh_reference: 穿红衣的女孩从跪姿站起，沿灯光昏暗的走廊移动。

source: High velocity, rapid acceleration, energetic movement.
zh_reference: 高速、快速加速、充满活力的移动。

source: Low velocity, gradual acceleration, cautious movement.
zh_reference: 低速、逐渐加速、谨慎的移动。

source: The girl in red kneels to comfort the crouching boy in the dim hallway before running away.
zh_reference: 在昏暗的走廊里，穿红衣的女孩先跪下安慰蹲着的男孩，然后跑开。

source: Girl touches boy's shoulders and leans in close.
zh_reference: 女孩触碰男孩的肩膀，并凑近他。

source: Girl gestures without touching and maintains physical gap.
zh_reference: 女孩只做手势、不触碰，保持身体距离。

source: The girl transitions from a surprised expression to a gentle smile.
zh_reference: 女孩的表情从惊讶变为温柔的微笑。

source: Slow, gradual, and fluid transition to the smile.
zh_reference: 缓慢、渐进、流畅地转为微笑。

source: Fast, immediate, and sharp transition to the smile.
zh_reference: 快速、立即、突然地转为微笑。

source: The girl raises the sword sheath and grips the handle.
zh_reference: 女孩举起剑鞘，握住剑柄。

source: Fast, abrupt, and high-energy motion.
zh_reference: 快速、突然、高能量的动作。

source: The girl in green raises and grips the sword handle while the girl in the dark uniform stands nearby in the outdoor setting.
zh_reference: 户外场景中，穿绿衣的女孩举起并握住剑柄，穿深色制服的女孩站在旁边。

source: Girl in green acknowledges companion; both shift stance to face each other.
zh_reference: 穿绿衣的女孩注意到同伴，两人都调整站姿，面向对方。

source: Girl in green ignores companion; dark uniform girl remains still and facing forward.
zh_reference: 穿绿衣的女孩不理会同伴；穿深色制服的女孩保持静止，面朝前方。

source: The character rides a motorcycle towards the large wall.
zh_reference: 角色骑摩托车驶向那堵高大的墙。

source: Ride with high velocity, rapid acceleration, and high energy.
zh_reference: 高速、快速加速、充满活力地骑行。

source: Ride with low velocity, slow steady pace, and low energy.
zh_reference: 低速、缓慢稳定、低能量地骑行。

source: The character in the green cloak confronts the man in the top hat in the dimly lit room with cages.
zh_reference: 在昏暗的、放着笼子的房间里，穿绿色斗篷的角色与戴高礼帽的男子对峙。

source: High intensity, rapid movements, and aggressive force.
zh_reference: 高强度、快速的动作，力量具有攻击性。

source: Low intensity, slow movements, and restrained force.
zh_reference: 低强度、缓慢的动作，力量克制。

source: The character in the green cloak confronts the man in the top hat holding a staff in a dimly lit room with cages.
zh_reference: 在昏暗的、放着笼子的房间里，穿绿色斗篷的角色与手持手杖、戴高礼帽的男子对峙。

source: Character aggressively lunges forward to physically attack the man.
zh_reference: 角色猛地向前扑去，对男子进行身体攻击。

source: Character maintains stationary guarded stance for tense verbal exchange.
zh_reference: 角色保持原地不动的戒备姿态，进行紧张的言语交锋。

source: The girl in red makes a triumphant expression, and the girl with pigtails reacts happily while both remain seated outdoors.
zh_reference: 在户外，穿红衣的女孩露出得意的表情，扎双马尾的女孩开心地回应，两人都坐着。

source: High energy, rapid, and exaggerated facial motion.
zh_reference: 面部动作能量高、快速、夸张。

source: Low energy, slow, and subtle facial motion.
zh_reference: 面部动作能量低、缓慢、细微。

source: The girl in red smiles triumphantly while the girl in pink reacts.
zh_reference: 穿红衣的女孩得意地笑，穿粉衣的女孩作出反应。

source: Girl in pink mirrors excitement with a wide, happy smile.
zh_reference: 穿粉衣的女孩同样兴奋，露出灿烂开心的笑容。

source: Girl in pink remains passive with a small, polite smile.
zh_reference: 穿粉衣的女孩表现被动，只是礼貌地微微一笑。

source: The chef throws the red tomato with a determined expression against a blue sky.
zh_reference: 以蓝天为背景，厨师带着坚定的表情扔出红番茄。

source: High velocity, explosive force, and rapid acceleration.
zh_reference: 高速、爆发力强、快速加速。

source: Low velocity, gentle force, and smooth deceleration.
zh_reference: 低速、力量轻柔、平稳减速。

source: A person sits on the floor next to a motorcycle inside a dimly lit cell.
zh_reference: 一个人坐在昏暗牢房的地上，旁边有一辆摩托车。

source: The person remains seated with minimal movement and slow pacing.
zh_reference: 这个人保持坐姿，动作很少、节奏缓慢。

source: The person stands up and mounts the motorcycle with rapid motion.
zh_reference: 这个人迅速站起来，跨上摩托车。

source: The character tilts the metallic surface upwards to reveal the reflection of their surprised face.
zh_reference: 角色把金属表面向上倾斜，露出自己惊讶表情的倒影。

source: Smooth, controlled, and gradual upward movement.
zh_reference: 平稳、受控、渐进地向上移动。

source: Abrupt, jerky, and high-energy upward movement.
zh_reference: 突然、急促、高能量地向上移动。

source: The character falls asleep while staring at the sky, with eyelids closing until eyes are shut.
zh_reference: 角色凝望天空时睡着了，眼皮慢慢合上直到闭眼。

source: Eyelids flutter gently and close over a sustained period.
zh_reference: 眼皮轻轻颤动，在较长一段时间里慢慢合上。

source: Eyes snap shut immediately in a sudden motion.
zh_reference: 眼睛猛地一下子闭上。

source: The taller character hugs the shorter character while both express surprise.
zh_reference: 较高的角色拥抱较矮的角色，两人都表现出惊讶。

source: Sudden, rapid acceleration into a rigid, high-force tight hug.
zh_reference: 突然、快速地加速，变成僵硬、用力很大的紧紧拥抱。

source: Slow, gradual acceleration into a soft, yielding gentle hug.
zh_reference: 缓慢、逐渐地加速，变成柔软、放松的轻柔拥抱。

source: The taller character initiates a hug with the shorter character in front of the wooden door.
zh_reference: 在木门前，较高的角色主动拥抱较矮的角色。

source: The taller character squeezes the shorter character tightly with significant force.
zh_reference: 较高的角色用很大的力气紧紧抱住较矮的角色。

source: The taller character maintains a loose, gentle embrace without applying pressure.
zh_reference: 较高的角色保持宽松、轻柔的拥抱，不施加压力。

source: The character charges forward from the current position.
zh_reference: 角色从当前位置向前冲锋。

source: Explosive, high-velocity burst with immediate acceleration.
zh_reference: 爆发式的高速冲出，立即加速。

source: Heavy, momentum-building advance with gradual acceleration.
zh_reference: 沉重地逐步积累动量推进，逐渐加速。

source: The character in the beige hoodie engages in a tense conversation in front of the dark curtain.
zh_reference: 穿米色连帽衫的角色在深色帘子前进行一场紧张的对话。

source: Explosive shouting with rapid movements and high physical energy.
zh_reference: 爆发式地大喊，动作快速，身体能量很高。

source: Controlled speaking with slower pacing and restrained body language.
zh_reference: 有控制地说话，节奏较慢，肢体语言克制。

source: A girl with blonde hair stands on a balcony holding a juice box, gazing at the sunset over the ocean.
zh_reference: 一个金发女孩站在阳台上，拿着一盒果汁，眺望海上的日落。

source: Minimal movement; only subtle slow sway of hair and juice box.
zh_reference: 动作很少；只有头发和果汁盒轻微、缓慢地晃动。

source: Vigorous swig, quick body turn, hand gestures, and rapid hair motion.
zh_reference: 大口猛喝，迅速转身，配合手势，头发快速摆动。

source: The character opens their eyes while orange sparkles appear around their face.
zh_reference: 角色睁开眼睛，脸部周围出现橙色闪光。

source: Eyes open slowly and gently with soft, gradual sparkles.
zh_reference: 眼睛缓慢、轻柔地睁开，闪光柔和、逐渐出现。

source: Eyes snap open suddenly with a burst of intense sparkles.
zh_reference: 眼睛猛地睁开，同时迸发出强烈的闪光。

source: The girl closes her eyes and then opens them.
zh_reference: 女孩闭上眼睛，然后睁开。

source: The girl opens her eyes with a fast, sharp, energetic motion.
zh_reference: 女孩以快速、干脆、有活力的动作睁开眼睛。

source: The girl opens her eyes with a slow, gradual, smooth motion.
zh_reference: 女孩以缓慢、渐进、平滑的动作睁开眼睛。

source: The character raises his hand to touch his own ear.
zh_reference: 角色抬手触摸自己的耳朵。

source: Slow, fluid, and low-energy motion.
zh_reference: 动作缓慢、流畅、低能量。

source: Fast, sharp, and high-energy motion.
zh_reference: 动作快速、干脆、高能量。
